en: A third-class lever like a fishing rod requires more input force than the output force but gains speed and distance for the load.
Friction between your rubber shoes and the floor pushes you forward when you walk, so friction can cause motion rather than only stop it.
On the Moon, astronaut David Scott dropped a hammer and a feather simultaneously, and both hit the ground at the same time because gravity accelerates all objects equally.
A magnet attracts iron, nickel, and cobalt but cannot pick up an aluminum can or a copper coin because those metals are not ferromagnetic.
Electric current flows in a complete closed circuit from the battery through the wires and back to the battery, so electrons are never used up.
Sunlight takes about eight minutes and twenty seconds to travel 150 million kilometers to reach Earth, proving light has a finite speed of 300,000 kilometers per second.
Sound cannot travel through outer space because it requires vibrating particles in a medium like air, water, or steel to carry its waves.
Heat always flows from a warmer object to a cooler object, so ice melts in your hand because heat moves from your skin into the ice.
A roller coaster at the top of a hill has maximum potential energy that transforms into kinetic energy as it speeds down, but total energy stays constant.
A ramp reduces the force needed to lift a box but increases the distance you push it, so the total work done equals lifting it straight up.
If you cut a bar magnet in half, each piece becomes a new magnet with its own north pole and south pole, never an isolated single pole.
You see lightning before hearing thunder because light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second while sound travels only about 343 meters per second in air.
